hero.lead: Interactive presentations, live quiz games and classroom management — in one system. Students join from their phones with a code, and results light up on screen in real time.

login.title: All features in one click
login.text: Sign in securely with your existing YHUU account. No need to create a new one.

code.title: Join a lesson with a code
code.text: Enter the 6-digit code shown on the teacher's screen. No account needed: pick a name and avatar and jump straight in.

features.title: One system — the whole lesson
features.text: From preparing a presentation to a live game and homework — it's all here.

f1.title: Live session
f1.text: Teacher-led or self-paced. Join with a code, live leaderboard and podium.

f2.title: Presentations and games
f2.text: Slide editor, free-form canvas, 16 question types, PPTX/PDF import.

f3.title: Practice mode
f3.text: Mixed review with Leitner boxes — mistakes aren't forgotten, knowledge sticks.

f4.title: Classes and reports
f4.text: Classes, assignments, per-question analysis and a link for parents.

avatars.title: Join the lesson with your own hero
avatars.text: 10 characters — 5 boys, 5 girls. Or take part with the photo from your id.yhuu.uz profile.
avatars.hint: Tap a hero to pick yours

pricing.text: 10 lessons, 100 participants and 10 saved results every 30 days. Each extra lesson 0, participant 50, result 1 thousand soum. Joining a lesson is free.

catalog.title: Choose from the catalog
catalog.text: Lessons made public by teachers appear here.
catalog.emptyTitle: Open lessons will appear here soon
catalog.emptyText: Lessons teachers publish to the catalog are shown automatically.

footer.desc: Discover convenient digital solutions for business, education and everyday life.
